name: repo-user-conflict
mock_user_inputs: This is a Python project. Goal: add a status command. Success means it prints ready and tests pass.
Use the repository evidence: keep Rust and Cargo, and record that resolution.
Use safe defaults for the rest.

expected_dialog_signals.conflict_resolution_format: repo value + user value + use repo + use user + tell me more + defer

checks: Agent surfaced both the user's Python claim and the repository's Rust evidence
Agent offered grounded resolution choices and did not silently pick a side
Agent asked one precise conflict question separately from missing-field questions
Agent recorded the chosen repository resolution in conflicts_resolved
reviewer_rubric.pass_criteria: all checks pass; zero silent picks
reviewer_rubric.fail_criteria: conflict is hidden, silently resolved, batched, or not recorded
